name: html-preview
description: Preview HTML files inside Claude Code as you build them, using a browser-backed pane or the supported terminal browser instead of opening a separate window.
sourceDescription: Shows HTML files Claude writes (or /preview <file>) like a browser: terminal-browser when installed, else a built-in Chrome-rendered pane
author: JAICHANGPARK

category.label: Web Mods
category.basis: Supports browser use, search or web previews.
